name: smoothed bigram probability ordering
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=2).train("ababa")
prob_b = model.prob("a", "b")
prob_a = model.prob("a", "a")
assert prob_b > prob_a > 0.0
assert math.isclose(prob_a + prob_b, 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert model.prob("z", "a") > 0.0
assert model.prob("z", "b") > 0.0
assert math.isclose(model.prob("z", "a") + model.prob("z", "b"), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert model.prob("a", "z") == 0.0

name: unigram probabilities and perplexity
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=1).train("aab")
prob_a = model.prob("ignored", "a")
prob_b = model.prob("ignored", "b")
assert prob_a > prob_b > 0.0
assert math.isclose(prob_a + prob_b, 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
score = model.perplexity("ab")
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert score >= 1.0
assert math.isinf(model.perplexity(""))

name: train resets previous state
test:
model = NGramCharModel(n=2)
assert model.train("aaaa") is model
assert model.prob("a", "a") == 1.0
model.train("bb")
assert model.prob("b", "b") == 1.0
assert model.prob("a", "a") == 0.0
assert model.prob("a", "b") == 1.0

name: seeded top-k sampling excludes lower-ranked characters
test:
import random
model = NGramCharModel(n=1).train("aaabbc")
random.seed(7)
samples = [model.sample_top_k("", k=2) for _ in range(300)]
assert set(samples) <= {"a", "b"}
assert "a" in samples
assert "b" in samples

name: k larger than vocabulary samples from all known characters
invalid arguments and untrained behavior
input: n = 0, empty train text, untrained sampling
test:
import math

def expect_value_error(callable_obj):
    try:
        callable_obj()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")

expect_value_error(lambda: NGramCharModel(n=0))
model = NGramCharModel()
expect_value_error(lambda: model.train(""))
expect_value_error(lambda: model.sample_top_k("", k=1))
assert model.prob("", "a") == 0.0
assert math.isinf(model.perplexity("abc"))
model.train("abc")
expect_value_error(lambda: model.sample_top_k("", k=0))
assert math.isinf(model.perplexity("az"))

name: tiny Shakespeare held-out probability workflow
test:
import math
import os
import random
from pathlib import Path

data_root = os.environ.get("DEEPCODE_DATA_PATH")
assert data_root, "DEEPCODE_DATA_PATH must point to a directory containing tiny_shakespeare.txt"
text = (Path(data_root) / "tiny_shakespeare.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
assert len(text) >= 1000, "tiny_shakespeare.txt is unexpectedly small for a held-out split"
cut = int(len(text) * 0.8)
train_text = text[:cut]
validation_text = text[cut:]
assert len(validation_text) >= 200, "validation split is too small"
training_vocab = set(train_text)
heldout = "".join(ch for ch in validation_text if ch in training_vocab)[:1000]
assert len(heldout) >= 200, "held-out split has too little known-vocabulary text"
model = NGramCharModel(n=4).train(train_text)
score = model.perplexity(heldout)
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert 1.0 <= score <= max(100.0, len(training_vocab) * 2.5)
random.seed(13)
samples = [model.sample_top_k(heldout[:20], k=10) for _ in range(50)]
assert set(samples) <= training_vocab
